figures.title: Two designs for supporting more than one grading scheme
figures.description: Two panels. The left shows the flag design: a single Gradebook box containing a scheme flag, with three separate operations each containing an if-else branch on that flag, and a note that adding a third scheme means editing every branch. The right shows the hierarchy design: an abstract GradingScheme box at the top with two boxes below it, PointsBased and Weighted, connected by lines, and a note that adding a third scheme means adding one box and editing nothing.
